facts.business: SIS Limited is a leading provider of security solutions, facility management, and cash logistics services across India, Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore.
key_risks: Rising customer expectations around compliance and governance
Impairment of investments in subsidiaries and joint ventures
Deferred tax asset recognition and measurement uncertainty
facts.related_party_note: Inter-segment revenue eliminations of ₹78.80 crore in FY26 and ₹64.28 crore in FY25; corporate guarantees provided by parent for subsidiary loans; acquisitions from related parties including AP Securitas and SDS.
